name: SCCache Warmup

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  CARGO_NET_RETRY: 10
  RUSTUP_MAX_RETRIES: 10
  RUST_BACKTRACE: short

jobs:
  warmup:
    name: Warm up sccache
    runs-on: ubuntu-ghcloud
    if: "!github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-x86_64
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: ubuntu-arm64
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: windows-x86_64
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - os: macos-x86_64
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - os: macos-arm64
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # pin@v6.0.2

      - name: Setup sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9
        with:
          version: "v0.9.0"
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Debug build
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"
        env:
          SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: walrus-sccache
          SCCACHE_GCS_REGION: us-west1
          SCCACHE_GCS_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}
          SCCACHE_READONLY: 0

      - name: Release build
        run: |
          cargo build --release
        env:
          SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: walrus-sccache
          SCCACHE_GCS_REGION: us-west1
          SCCACHE_GCS_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}
          SCCACHE_READONLY: 0

      - name: Post sccache
        run: |
          echo "Cache stats:"
          sccache --show-stats
        env:
          SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: walrus-sccache
          SCCACHE_GCS_REGION: us-west1
          SCCACHE_GCS_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}
          SCCACHE_READONLY: 1

  notify_failure:
    name: Notify on failure
    needs: warmup
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch failure notification
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd # pin@v8.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.actions.createWorkflowDispatch({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'sui-operations',
              ref: 'main'
            })
